title: Comparing local trips: walk, cycle, bus, Metro, train, carpool, two-wheeler, car
summary: For Hyderabad and other Indian cities, short trips can often use walking, cycling, TSRTC or city buses, Metro, suburban rail, carpool, or a two-wheeler. EcoPath.AI compares the costs and kilometres you enter. It does not invent fares or emission factors.
content:
Enter the one-way or round-trip distance in kilometres and how many days per week you make the trip. Then enter the cost you actually pay (fuel for a scooter/car, Metro token or pass, bus ticket). Walking and cycling have no ticket cost; you may enter optional maintenance.

Hyderabad has a Metro network and extensive bus services. Whether a given door-to-door trip is realistic depends on your corridor, weather, and safety — the app cannot verify that from a map you have not provided.

Emissions: passenger-km factors for Indian modes are not hardcoded. If you have a documented factor you trust, you may enter it in Compare; otherwise the tool reports cost and distance only.
applicability_conditions: Makes regular trips in an Indian city
implementation_steps: Measure typical trip distance in km (odometer, Metro station distance, or maps)
Record current mode and monthly rupee cost
Use Compare to enter alternatives (walk, cycle, bus, Metro, train, carpool, personal vehicle)
Do not assume Metro is available for every neighbourhood
limitations: No official TSRTC or Hyderabad Metro fare table is stored
Safety, heat, and last-mile access are user judgements
source_title: User-entered travel records (no invented fare table)
